Lipoprotein metabolism disorder; atherosclerosis and fatty liver are separate diagnoses. Xanthomas, corneal arcus and lipemia retinalis usually lack functional damage.

Amino-acid transport/metabolic disorder with hyperammonemia; neurologic injury and malabsorption frequencies are unclear. Aminoaciduria alone does not establish renal damage.
SDS with inherited marrow failure, immunodeficiency and exocrine pancreatic dysfunction; skeletal abnormalities occur in roughly half of reported DNAJC21 cases; estimates remain limited.
